summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of new Finanças 'Perfil Financeiro' feature. All 9 requested scenarios PASSED end-to-end: login as admin, /financas loads, both tabs present and switchable, empty state -> editor -> save flow works, profile-view metrics are mathematically correct, cost-structure renders correctly, CEO analysis (LLM) returns proper diagnostico/riscos/prioridades/acoes, edit-profile re-opens pre-filled, Movimentos flow (add entry, summary cards) still functional. No console errors or blank screens.

verification_details.ceo_analysis: Returned in ~6s with diagnostico + 3 riscos + 3 prioridades + 3 acoes (each with titulo/impacto). Rendered correctly under [data-testid=ceo-analysis].
verification_details.editor_prefill: revenue=25000, cash=40000, varpct=30, cost-name-0=Salários — all pre-filled correctly on re-open.
verification_details.movimentos: add-entry with amount=1234, category=TEST_receita saved and listed; Receitas €1234 / Despesas €0 / Resultado €1234 summary cards render.

critical_code_review_comments: Finances.jsx is 321 lines and mixes two very different concerns (perfil + movimentos). Consider splitting the Perfil tab (editor dialog + metric cards + cost-structure + ceo-analysis blocks) into its own component/file for maintainability.
Analysis fetch has no explicit loading state text once triggered (button hides, only a spinner shows). Users waiting 5-10s see silence; consider a 'A analisar…' inline message.
seed_data_creation: Saved a financial profile (25000/40000/30% + Salários 9000, Renda 2500) and created one Movimentos entry (TEST_receita, 1234). Admin profile is no longer empty after this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perfil Financeiro feature is fully functional end-to-end. If retesting the empty-state flow, the admin's financial profile now contains sample data; reset via backend if the empty state needs re-verification.
